releaseNotes.zh-CN:
MyCodex 8.0.3 更新日志

• 在手机上回答待回答问题
Codex 留下的待回答问题会同步到 MyCodex Android 1.5.0 及以上版本，可在手机上回答或忽略；任一端处理后，另一端自动关闭。

• 审批和提问提示统一
审批、工具与 MCP 输入、待回答问题使用同一套提示：音效开关在前台和后台都生效；窗口在后台时会在音效后播报请求，在前台不再播报，由读屏软件朗读弹框。后台收到待回答问题后切回 MyCodex，问题窗口会直接来到前台。

• 认证中心改进
DeepSeek 等提供商切换上游格式时会自动改用对应的端点地址，修复切换到 Anthropic 格式后请求返回 404 的问题。上游格式标明直连或协议转换；请求头和请求体覆盖改为列表编辑，键盘和读屏操作更方便。有任务运行时也能添加和编辑未使用的提供商。错误改用标准错误框提示，启用提供商成功后会语音确认。

• 其他修复
修复退出时可能卡住的问题，并为部分原本静默失败的操作补充诊断日志。
releaseNotes.en-US:
MyCodex 8.0.3 Release Notes

• Answer pending questions on your phone
Pending questions left by Codex now sync to MyCodex Android 1.5.0 or later, where you can answer or ignore them. Once either side handles a question, it closes on the other.

• Consistent prompts for approvals and questions
Approvals, tool and MCP input, and pending questions now share one set of prompts. The sound setting applies in both the foreground and background. In the background, the request is spoken after the sound; in the foreground, nothing is spoken and your screen reader reads the dialog. Switching back to MyCodex after a pending question arrives in the background now brings the question window to the front.

• Authentication Center improvements
When you change the upstream format of a provider such as DeepSeek, its matching endpoint address is now used, fixing 404 errors after switching to the Anthropic format. Upstream formats now state whether they connect directly or convert the protocol. Header and body overrides are edited as lists, which is easier with a keyboard and screen reader. Unused providers can be added and edited while tasks are running. Errors now appear in a standard error dialog, and enabling a provider is confirmed by speech.

• Other fixes
Fixed a possible hang when exiting, and added diagnostic logs for several operations that previously failed silently.
